sentences.text: Ants live together in colonies, which are eusocial, communal, and efficiently organized.
A typical colony consists of one or more egg-laying queens, numerous sterile females, and seasonally, many winged sexual males and females.
Ants undertake flights to establish new colonies, with swarms of winged sexuals departing the nest in search of other nests.
The males die shortly thereafter, while a small percentage of females survive to initiate new nests.
Ant colonies operate with a unified purpose, with each caste playing a vital role in the colony's survival.
Ants have colonized almost every landmass on Earth.
